Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly extracted Don Sharp's birth year as 1875 from the Wikipedia infobox of the film page. This is a hallucination or a severe parsing error, as Don Sharp was a contemporary director of the 1978 film and was born in 1908 (died 1995). A birth year of 1875 would make him 103 years old at the time of the 1978 film, which is impossible. This erroneous data point (1875 vs 1895) would have led the Planner to incorrectly conclude that Don Sharp was born earlier than Benjamin Stoloff (1895), reversing the correct answer. The agent failed to verify this date against the director's Wikipedia page or other reliable sources before reporting it as a fact.
